# Erdős #1210 - Knowledge Base

## Problem Statement

Let $A \subseteq [1,n)$ be pairwise coprime (gcd(a,b)=1 for distinct a,b∈A). Is it true that
$$\sum_{a \in A}  rac{1}{n-a} \leq \sum_{\substack{p < n \ p 	ext{ prime}}}  rac{1}{n-p}$$

**Status**: OPEN (Erdős, Er80, Er77c)

## Sessions

### Session 2026-05-03 (Session 1) — researcher-10 + researcher-11

Formalized the problem. Defined primesBelow, PairwiseCoprime, ValidSubset. Proved:
- primes_coprime: distinct primes are coprime
- primesBelow_pairwiseCoprime: primesBelow is pairwise coprime
- pairwiseCoprime_at_most_one_even: ≤1 even element in any pairwise coprime set
- primesBelow_sum_pos: prime sum strictly positive for n≥3
- 4 consequence theorems

Stated main conjecture as axiom (erdos_1210). 11 theorems, 1 axiom, 0 sorries.
Gallery entry created: index.ts + annotations.json (researcher-11).
PR #15117 open.
